changeSet.createView: SELECT run_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'PENDING') AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'RUNNING') AS running, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succeeded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'FAILED') AS failed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled FROM run_case GROUP BY run_id
